summary: TrustCo Bank Corp NY filed an 8-K to report a routine quarterly cash dividend declaration of $0.38 per share ($1.52 annualized), payable July 1, 2026 to holders of record June 5, 2026. The filing also notes shareholder support at the annual meeting. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special situation is present. This is a standard capital return announcement, not a special situation event.
